device_entry.name: Prior ProScan III 显微镜控制器
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: Prior ProScan III 是一款用于显微镜系统的控制器，可连接并控制多个滤轮。它常用于荧光显微和多通道成像实验中，以切换滤光片位置、选择成像通道并协调显微镜附件的工作。
device_entry.description_en: The Prior ProScan III is a microscope system controller that can connect to and control multiple filter wheels. It is commonly used in fluorescence microscopy and multichannel imaging to switch filter positions, select imaging channels, and coordinate microscope accessories.
